reason: I use AI at work every day, but I don't trust an AI with my money, and a cute pet doesn't change that. I already invest every payday myself in my broker app, so I'm not paying a monthly fee to hand that job to an agent.
objection: An AI moving real money for me, even within limits. If it makes a bad trade or misreads something, a downloadable record and a kill switch only tell me what went wrong afterwards. Real-money accounts and the broker partner don't exist yet either.
would_change_my_mind: A real licensed, insured broker behind it, plus a long public track record where people can show the agent never went past their limits or lost money through its own mistakes.
